notes: Version 1.0.235 — signature database expanded to 428 file types (682 signatures) and smarter extension recovery.
changelog: New: signature database expanded to 428 file types (682 signatures) — RAW files from all major camera brands, HEIF/AVIF, camera video (MTS, R3D, BRAW, MXF), Apple iWork, LibreOffice, KeePass, virtual disks and more.
Fixed: newer Nikon NEF and other RAW files were wrongly reported as having a bad signature.
Improved: Recover extensions creates one copy with the correct extension instead of one copy per matching type.
Fixed: signature verification run together with the HEX scan now checks only the selected extensions.
Also includes everything from 1.0.230: multi-partition .acerep reports, R-Studio/DMDE/UFS Explorer import, reusable thumbnails, more accurate damaged-file detection.
